Chotey Hazrat Nadeem Sarwar Lyrics

1
Abbas Alamdar.
Kya Howa Kyun Udas Betha Hai.
Tu Azadar-e-Ibn-e-Zahra Hai.
Chal Wahan Rab Jahan Pe Milta Hai.
Chal Jahan Panjtan Ka Saya Hai.
Woh Sakhi Dar Khula Hi Rehta Hai.

2
Chotay Hazrat Ki Bargah Chalo.
Chalo Abbas Ki Dargah Chalo.
Inn Ki Dargah Se Sogat-e-Wafa Milti Hai.
Nam-e-Zainab Pe Yahan Sab Ko Rida Milti Hai.
Zairo Aao Sakina Ki Dua Milti Hai.
Mere Saqqay Ke Azadar Geo.

3
Haan Yehi Baab-e-Hawaij Hai Dua-e-Zahra.
Yeh Ali Ka Hai Sarapa Tu Hasan Ka Chehra.
Inn Ko Kehte Hain Hussain Ibn-e-Ali Ka Pyara.
Panjtan Pak Ke Pyaray Se Kaho.
Hazari Inn Ki Jab Hoti Hai Diye Jaltay Hain.
Mustafa Fatima Hasnain-o-Ali Aate Hain.

4
Mil Ke Sab Madar-e-Abbas Se Farmatay Hain.
Aao Abbas Ki Tum Nazar Tu Do.
Inn Ka Jab Aath Muharram Ko Alam Uthta Hai.
Aik Mashkeza Bhi Panjay Se Bandha Rehta Hai.
Oss Pe Saqa-e-Sakina Bhi Likha Rehta Hai.
Yeh Alam Kya Hai Sakina Se Suno.

5
Jis Ne Nu Lakh Ke Lashkar Ka Bharam Toor Diya.
Oss Pe Ik Mashk Ke Chidne Ne Sitam Toor Diya.
Ya Sakina Kaha Our Khak Pe Dam Toor Diya.
Mil Ke Sab Matam-e-Abbas Karo.
Zamin-e-Chadar-e-Zainab They Alamdar-e-Wafa.
Jis Ghari Sani-e-Zahra Se Yeh Fizza Ne Kaha.

6
Chadrein Apni Sanbhalo Keh Woh Ghazi Na Raha.
Pursa Ab Zainab-o-Kulsoom Ko Do.
Chotay Hazrat Ki Ghulami Ka Sharf Paya Hai.
Rab-e-Kaba Ki Qasam Yeh Bara Sarmaya Hai.
Noha Jo:SARWAR-o-REHAN: Se Parhwaya Hai.
Shukar-e-Maula Chalo Ghazi Se Kaho.

7
Chotay Hazrat Hussain Ke Bhai.
Chotay Hazrat Ba Haq-e-Saqayi.
Tum Waseela Ho Gham Ke Maron Ka.
Tum Waseela Ho Be Saharon Ka.
Bargah-e-Khuda Mein Aye Ghazi.
Aap Ki Baat Rad Nahi Hoti.

8
Dil Ki Uljhan Nikal Do Maula.
Meri Mushkil Ko Taal Do Maula.
Yeh Gunahgar Bhi Tumhara Hai.
Iss Liye Aap Ko Pukara Hai.
Dard Ki Ab Koi Dawa Bhejo.
Ab Mujhe Karbala Bola Bhejo.

9
Wasta Syed-e-Madina Ka.
Wasta Zainab-o-Sakina Ka.
Bibi Umm Ul-Baneen Ka Sadqa.
Wasta Panjtan Ka Deta Hoon.
Wasta Be Kafan Ka Deta Hoon.
Chotay Hazrat Hussain Ke Bhai.
